svg.aria-label: A keyboard from C3 to C5. C3 and C4 are each marked with a filled circle. A neutral bracket joins them: two different keys one octave apart. Not a Week 2 interval.
svg.title: Week 1 used C3; Week 2 starts at C4

g.text: Week 1 started on C3. Week 2 starts on C4.
C3 and C4: two different keys, one
Week 1: C3 · Week 2: C4. Same letter, a different key.
How to read this graphic: Find the two marked C keys: C3 on the left, C4 in the middle.
Each C is the white key just left of a group of two black keys. The bracket joins them;
it is a comparison between two registers, not an interval you will study this week.
